rules.sentence: The prevalence of biochemical GH deficiency in all HIV-infected patients was approximately 30% when a peak GH value cutoff of 7.5 to 9.0 μg/L was used.
The prevalence of GH deficiency remained significantly elevated at 15% when a lower cutoff of 5 μg/L was used.
Even with a cutoff of 4.2 μg/L, the standard for non-HIV-infected patients with obesity, the prevalence of GH deficiency remains elevated at 10%.[24]
